title: His father the trumpeter and his mother's love of music
summary: His father played a little trumpet, his mother loved music and dancing, and he was raised by her after his parents separated.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Everybody think it was a big hit in the old days. Oh yeah. It was a hit I guess too. In fact. Yeah. Can you remember the first music you ever heard? Did your parents play any instruments or sing?

Well, my father, he played a little trumpet. I never heard him play anything. I was quite young at that time. Yeah. But I understood that he played a little trumpet, you know, he was a trumpet player. My mother always, she loved music and everything, but she didn't play anything.
Probably sang good though I bet.

And dance, she liked dancing. She was crazy about dancing. I remember in my early days my parents separated and I was raised by my mother and I was very young and I remember on various occasions that she would say, now you sure you're alright to stay at home by yourself? I was quite young. Yeah. And I would say, yeah, well you go on out and enjoy yourself. And she would come back and tell me about that. One thing that stands out in my mind, it was a cabaret or something, Pete Lollis. It was, it was down the, downtown, not too far. Yeah.
About Murray and the Custom House or I don't know.

Yeah. And she was talking about Steve Lewis all the time, what a wonderful pianist he was. And unfortunately I never got to hear him or anything because I was a little young for that sort of thing. But she was always saying what a wonderful pianist he was and saying when you get to be a big boy I want you to be a musician and those kind of things.
